data.exact_reserve_text: In 2015, there has been an overall surplus of GBP 1.8 million on prior year reserves. This has been primarily generated by better than expected claims experience on the property reinsurance class of business.
data.standardized_narrative: In 2015, Syndicate 6117 reported a prior year reserve release of GBP 1.8 million, representing a 75.16% release relative to its opening gross claims outstanding. This favorable development was primarily driven by better than expected claims experience within the property reinsurance class of business. No specific events or years were mentioned as contributing to this movement.
raw_causal_phrases: better than expected claims experience on the property reinsurance class of business.
data.data_quality_notes: The claims development table only includes two underwriting years (2014 and 2015), making it unsuitable for calculating prior year development from the triangle method. The prior year development figure was explicitly stated in the narrative.
